gen-gf-waiting-for-the-sunrise-fs-public: Public Sans has a hefty, sturdy body with broad openings in its curves. Waiting for the Sunrise brings a handwritten friendliness against it, and that loose hand beside the firm sans-serif is the pair's real charm.
gen-gf-waiting-for-the-sunrise-fs-suprem: Waiting for the Sunrise looks handwritten and inviting, its letters nested close like links in a chain. Supreme sets a crisp, heavy-looking sans strip beneath it, and the loose hand against that firm line is what sticks.
gen-gf-waiting-for-the-sunrise-general-s: Friendly, in a pen-drawn sort of way, with a loose g that stays open. General Sans follows with a smooth, steady line and a tall lowercase, so the handwriting feels relaxed beside something tidier.
gen-gf-waiting-for-the-sunrise-manrope: Inviting handwriting leads here, its lowercase filling most of the height and its g left open below. Manrope brings bright gaps in every curve and one steady line width, a tidier counterpart to the looseness above.
gen-gf-waiting-for-the-sunrise-montserra: That open-bottomed g gives Waiting for the Sunrise its handwritten, friendly stamp, with letters nested like a short chain. And Montserrat glides along beneath it with generous white space leading into every curve, so a longer read stays easy on the eye.
gen-gf-waiting-for-the-sunrise-satoshi: Satoshi reads approachably, with a soaring x-height and an open e that never pinches shut, every stroke cut to one width. Make Waiting for the Sunrise small and its handwriting gets lost.
gen-gf-waiting-for-the-sunrise-switzer: Switzer reads like bent wire, tall in the waist, with c tips that keep their distance. Beside it, Waiting for the Sunrise adds handwritten warmth, and the two sit together as a loose hand next to a drawn line.
gen-gf-waiting-for-the-sunrise-work-sans: Work Sans looks modern, with its mean line set high and c tips that never drift toward touching. And Waiting for the Sunrise lends a handwritten friendliness that gives the pair its warmth.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Wallpoet leaves paper showing through between its letters, which gives it a stencil-like, commanding look up top. And BhuTuka Expanded One slows the pace beneath it, so give the heading a little extra size to hold its own.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-hepta-slab: Loud, cut-through lettering with high lowercase and gaps where the paper shows, courtesy of Wallpoet. Hepta Slab stretches out below it, open and bookish, so the two sit like a poster over a printed page.
